app_summary: An online shop selling astronomy products, based on the OpenTelemetry Demo. It is built with polyglot microservices (Go, Java, .NET, Python, Node.js, Rust, ...) communicating via gRPC and HTTP behind an Envoy frontend-proxy, with Kafka for asynchronous order processing and Valkey as cart store. Supported Operations: View product catalog, Receive product recommendations and ads, Add item to cart, Checkout with selected items, Currency conversion, Process payment, Generate shipping quotes, Send order confirmation emails

rca_analyses_list.diagnosis: No user-facing application failure was found. The frontend and frontend-proxy pods are Running and serving requests (HTTP 200s and successful orders). The problem is with the telemetry infrastructure: the OpenTelemetry Collector agent (pod otel-collector-agent-mmx26) cannot scrape kubelet stats due to TLS verification failures against the node kubelet (Get "https://172.18.0.6:10250/stats/summary": x509: cannot validate certificate for 172.18.0.6 because it doesn't contain any IP SANs), and the collector also logs DNS resolver errors ("lookup firepit on 10.96.0.10:53: server misbehaving") causing gRPC resolver errors. These telemetry failures explain missing traces/trace queries (get_traces returned no results) and gaps in metrics, but they do not impact application request handling.
